The '''Dungeon Sack''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Sacks|Sack]] that holds items that drop in [[The Catacombs]], such as [[Spirit Leap]], [[Superboom TNT]], [[L.A.S.R.'s Eye]] etc.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Dungeon Sack''' can be bought from {{NPCSprite|Elizabeth}} in the {{zone|Community Center}} for {{Bits|14k}}.

== Usage ==
The '''Dungeon Sack''' can store items related to [[Dungeons]].
